deal.opex_aed.service_charge.note: not stated and no mandate default; taken as 0

deal.opex_aed.marketing_leasing.note: not stated and no mandate default; taken as 0

deal.opex_aed.sinking_fund.note: missing from the operating statement; mandate default 2.0 AED/sqft NSA x1.5 for building age 11 years

mandate.underwriting.debt.rate_note.value: 3M EIBOR held flat over the hold, unhedged; a 5-year swap would replace it in diligence

mandate.underwriting.tax.model.value: indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

exit_yield.note: max(area house view, entry yield on price) + expansion + age premium

occupancy_by_units.note: occupied, under renewal or notice served / all units; legal-case and vacant units are not occupied

in_place_rent_aed.note: contract rent of occupied units; vacant and legal-case units carry none

screen_reference_rent_aed.note: all units at the as-of screen reference rent (a proxy, not the RERA index)

over_rent_share_of_income.note: in-place rent of units let more than 10% above the screen reference rent / in-place rent

over_rent_excess_at_expiry_aed.note: rent above the reference on those units: the cut if each resets to the reference at its next renewal or expiry (not today)

max_expiry_share_quarter.note: largest share of in-place rent expiring in one of the 4 consecutive 3-month windows from the rent roll date (window 4: 2027-07-31 to 2027-10-30)

gross_rental_income_year1.note: unit-level rent (excludes any master lease rent)

commercial_income_share_year1.note: retail rent / total rent; sets the recoverable share of input VAT

gross_yield_in_place_on_price.note: broker convention: in-place rent / price, no costs

loan_aed.note: lower of max LTV and the loan Year-1 NOI covers at the sizing DSCR; binding: dscr

interest_rate.note: 3M EIBOR held flat over the hold, unhedged; a 5-year swap would replace it in diligence

equity_aed.note: price + acquisition costs + arrangement fee - loan

dscr_year1.note: Year-1 NOI / Year-1 debt service; at least the sizing DSCR by construction

breakeven_occupancy_dscr_1.note: economic occupancy of Year-1 potential income at which NOI equals debt service

economic_occupancy_year1.note: income after downtime and structural vacancy / potential income

exit_gain_levered_aed.note: net sale proceeds - (price + acquisition costs); taxed in the sale year

unlevered_irr_post_tax.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

unlevered_equity_multiple_post_tax.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). levered_equity_multiple_post_tax.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). walk_away_price_aed.note: highest price on a AED 10,000 grid meeting the target unlevered IRR (pre-tax); the exit yield follows the price through the entry yield

exit.rule: exit yield = max(area house view, the deal's Year-1 NOI yield on price) + expansion + age premium
exit.summary: Buy at 6.51% (Year-1 NOI on price); exit at 6.76% = max(area 6.50%, entry 6.51%) + 25 bps expansion + 0 bps age premium.

loan_constant.note: annual payment per AED of loan over 15 years

debt.rate_note: 3M EIBOR held flat over the hold, unhedged; a 5-year swap would replace it in diligence

closing_adjustments.note: tenant security deposits pass to the buyer as a liability; the seller credits them at closing. Shown for the closing statement only: not in NOI, cost or returns.

sinking_fund.note: 2.0 AED/sqft x1.5 for building age 11 years x 41,000 sqft NSA

unlevered_pre_tax.note: year 0: price + transfer costs; final year includes net sale

unlevered_post_tax.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

levered_pre_tax.note: year 0: equity; final year includes net sale less loan repayment

levered_post_tax.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

tax_unlevered.note: indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

tax_levered.note: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; final year adds the exit gain; indicative only; indicative only: taxable income = NOI - interest - arrangement fee amortisation; no depreciation; exit gain taxed at the same rate; ignores the holding vehicle (QIF/REIT regimes under Cabinet Decision 34/2025). The screen decides on pre-tax returns.

sensitivity.note: rent shift scales every year's reference rent level; in-place rents are unchanged until they roll; the exit shift is added on top of the exit yield rule; debt is re-sized in each cell

price_aed.note: highest price on a AED 10,000 grid meeting the target unlevered IRR (pre-tax); the exit yield follows the price through the entry yield

largest_swing_aed.note: largest change in the walk-away price across the four cases

unit_schedule.note: expected value over renewal and turnover outcomes; RERA bands apply to each renewing tenant's own rent; months counted from the analysis start

om_yield_check.summary: The OM says 8.27% (net on asking price); on a buyer's basis (Year-1 NOI on price plus acquisition costs) it is 6.13%.
